nodes.name: Slack - Nova Mensagem
nodes.notes: Monitora mensagens no canal #credgestor-alerts para comandos de aprovação

parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  id,
  timestamp,
  specialist_type,
  issues,
  diagnosis,
  action_plan,
  severity,
  status
FROM troubleshooting_reports
WHERE id = '{{ $json.reportId }}'::uuid
  AND status = 'pending_approval';

=UPDATE troubleshooting_reports
SET 
  status = 'approved',
  approved_by = '{{ $('Processar Comando').item.json.userName }} ({{ $('Processar Comando').item.json.userId }})',
  approved_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('Processar Comando').item.json.reportId }}'::uuid
RETURNING id, status, approved_by, approved_at;

=UPDATE troubleshooting_reports
SET 
  status = 'rejected',
  approved_by = '{{ $('Processar Comando').item.json.userName }} ({{ $('Processar Comando').item.json.userId }})',
  approved_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('Processar Comando').item.json.reportId }}'::uuid
RETURNING id, status, approved_by, approved_at;
